title: Very knowledgeable guide....

title: Can’t miss opportunity to learn about Jewish history and Barcelona
text: Sebastian was excellent. He had through knowledge of the history of Barcelona and the Jews.  We walked around the Gothic Quarter and saw so many things that we would have never seen on our own. Not only seeing them but stopping to learn the history behind them. Highly recommended
author: Donald_K

title: A wonderful experience
text: What a lovely afternoon with Florenta Vinas. Knowledgeable and her presentation was lovely. She was able to provide us with an experience we will never forget
author: Pamela L
